race_conditions.description: Concurrent workspace switches can corrupt state - isTransitioning flag is checked but not atomic
race_conditions.fix: Add mutex using a Promise-based lock queue to serialize transitions

race_conditions.description: Event listener errors are not caught - one throwing listener can crash entire event bus
race_conditions.fix: Wrap each listener call in try-catch with error isolation per listener

race_conditions.description: Dual write to Local FS and WebContainer is not atomic - partial failure leaves inconsistent state
race_conditions.fix: Implement two-phase write: prepare both, then commit; rollback on failure

race_conditions.description: setTimeout for transition end is not cancelable - rapid switches can leave stale timeouts
race_conditions.fix: Store timeout ID and clearTimeout in startTransition before setting new timeout

race_conditions.description: Debounce timers are module-level Map - not cleaned up on page unload
race_conditions.fix: Add cleanup in pagehide/unload event listener

race_conditions.description: writeMultiple iterates sequentially but no global lock - concurrent batches can interleave
race_conditions.fix: Add global mutex for batch operations across all files

non_idempotent_writes.description: Calling setCurrentWorkspace multiple times with same value still emits events and triggers timeouts
non_idempotent_writes.fix: Add early return if workspace value hasn't changed

non_idempotent_writes.description: Each content change creates a new debounce timer - rapid keystrokes can cause multiple saves
non_idempotent_writes.fix: Debounce is intentional but should track pending save state to avoid duplicate work

non_idempotent_writes.description: Emitting workspace change event multiple times for same transition - listeners may receive duplicate events
non_idempotent_writes.fix: Track recent emissions and deduplicate within short time window

non_idempotent_writes.description: Calling sync while already syncing throws error - should queue or debounce instead
non_idempotent_writes.fix: Queue subsequent sync requests to execute after current sync completes

missing_rollback.operation: Partial transition failure - if agent re-selection fails after workspace update
missing_rollback.compensation_action: Revert workspaceStore.setCurrentWorkspace to previous workspace, re-emit workspace:changed with original value

missing_rollback.operation: Dual write to Local FS succeeds but WebContainer write fails
missing_rollback.compensation_action: Delete the Local FS file to maintain consistency, or mark as needs-sync for retry

missing_rollback.operation: Local FS delete succeeds but WebContainer delete fails
missing_rollback.compensation_action: Re-create file in WebContainer from Local FS backup or mark for reconciliation

missing_rollback.operation: Rollback only deletes files - doesn't restore original content if files existed before
missing_rollback.compensation_action: Track pre-existing files and restore their original content, not just delete

missing_rollback.operation: Rollback creates empty files - doesn't restore original content
missing_rollback.compensation_action: Backup file content before deletion, restore full content on rollback

missing_rollback.operation: Cross-workspace event listeners may fail after workspace state is updated
missing_rollback.compensation_action: Wrap event emission in try-catch, log errors without failing the transition

proposed_tests.name: test_workspace_switch_concurrent
proposed_tests.description: Simultaneous workspace switches should be serialized
proposed_tests.expected_behavior: Only one transition executes, others wait or return early

proposed_tests.name: test_workspace_switch_partial_failure
proposed_tests.description: If agent re-selection fails mid-transition, workspace should revert
proposed_tests.expected_behavior: Workspace state restored to previous value, error propagated
proposed_tests.test_code: transitionTo('notes') with no agents available - should revert and throw

proposed_tests.name: test_event_listener_error_isolation
proposed_tests.description: One throwing event listener should not crash other listeners or the event bus
proposed_tests.expected_behavior: Throwing listener error is caught, other listeners still execute
proposed_tests.test_code: Emit event with one good and one throwing listener - good listener should still fire

proposed_tests.name: test_dual_write_rollback
proposed_tests.description: If WebContainer write fails after Local FS write, Local FS should be rolled back
proposed_tests.expected_behavior: Local FS file deleted or marked inconsistent after failed dual write
proposed_tests.test_code: writeFile when WebContainer is unavailable - Local FS should not have orphaned file

proposed_tests.name: test_batch_write_rollback_comprehensive
proposed_tests.description: writeMultiple rollback should restore pre-existing files, not just delete
proposed_tests.expected_behavior: Files that existed before batch write are restored with original content
proposed_tests.test_code: writeMultiple to overwrite existing files, then fail mid-way - originals should be restored

proposed_tests.name: test_sync_idempotency
proposed_tests.description: Calling sync multiple times should not cause duplicate operations
proposed_tests.expected_behavior: Subsequent sync calls should be queued or debounced, not throw
proposed_tests.test_code: await sync(); await sync(); await sync(); // Should not throw

proposed_tests.name: test_transition_timeout_cleanup
proposed_tests.description: Rapid workspace switches should not leave stale timeouts
proposed_tests.expected_behavior: Each transition has its own timeout that is properly cleaned up
proposed_tests.test_code: Switch workspaces 10 times rapidly - isTransitioning should eventually be false

proposed_tests.name: test_note_idempotent_save
proposed_tests.description: Calling save on same note multiple times should not cause issues
proposed_tests.expected_behavior: Each save completes, no duplicate work or errors
proposed_tests.test_code: await saveNoteToFile(id); await saveNoteToFile(id); // Both should succeed

critical_findings: Event listener errors are not isolated - can crash entire event bus
Dual write to Local FS and WebContainer is not atomic
Workspace transition partial failure has no rollback path
Batch file operations rollback is incomplete (doesn't restore originals)
recommendations: Priority 1: Wrap event listener calls in try-catch for error isolation
Priority 2: Implement two-phase dual-write pattern with rollback
Priority 3: Add transaction-like semantics to workspace transitions
Priority 4: Enhance batch operation rollback to preserve pre-existing state
Priority 5: Add global mutex for concurrent batch operations
